translation: Atziri, Atziri, star yonder, buried one, Vaal!
notes: Atziri: proper name, no dict hit. ek: Yucatec EK' estrella (star); longer than Kiche ek to go, so star. te: Yucatec te Aculla/Alla (yonder/there); TE convidador logged as alt. mucane: segmented Maya muka'n soterrado/enterrada cosa (buried). Vaal: proper name, no hit.

Teoyuxtlane: segmented Nahuatl teoyohtica holy + tlan place. ascensionada: Spanish ascender (ilide) feminine participle ascended. Yutsal: Maya UTS bello/hermoso/cosa buena; Cordemex yutsal ti' todo es bueno.

translation: Atziri, Atziri, do not rub the wound, Zerphi!
notes: ma: Yucatec MA' no (negative particle); longer than Kiche ma. kilya: Maya K'ILYAH estregar o lastimar la llaga (rub/wound a sore); leftover ya. Zerphi: proper name, no hit.

translation: At enchantment, entirely all! Although it appears, spark, good, air perhaps!
notes: Ti: Yucatec TI' en/por (at/in/to). itsok: ITS leche/lagrima/resina/goma plus residue ok (resin/tears/enchantment). anab: Yucatec unab Enteramente (entirely). nochira: Nahuatl nochi all/whole, residue ra. Kextal: Maya KEX aunque + TAL manifestarse. xi: Maya XI chispa (spark); Nahuatl xi- imperative come is alt. kujkuali: Nahuatl cualli/cuali good. ik'bala: IK' aire/viento + BALA' acaso (perhaps).
ikba'yucane: segmented IK' air + muka'n-like buried (same -cane as mucane). Weak compound. Vaal: name.

translation: You yonder, shake, tla-rubber turkey! You yonder, bug, tla-rubber kifba!
notes: A'te: Maya 2sg a (norma possessives a w-, u y-) + te yonder; read as vocative you yonder. 'Ibil: IBIL sacudir (shake) over EBIL stairs by seed 1729 tie-break, same length. tlayeb: Nahuatl tla- + Maya YEB; YEB senses ladder/rain/hule, seed pick hule rubber. kutsen: Maya KUTS; turkey vs plane/clean same length, seed pick turkey (pavo). ik'el: exact Cordemex/ilide ik'el bicho (bug) over IK'AL wind and IK'IL aerial by seed. kifba: no hit (K'IBA toponym lastimar la herida is weak alt).
ascenada: Spanish ascender. akal: Maya AKAL acercarse (approach); romper ropa is alt.

translation: No longer honorable, it wounds! No longer earth, jare, dawn!
notes: Aiokmo: Nahuatl aco no longer (Nahuatl 1100); ayamo not yet is longer but worse form (no k). til: Maya TIL honrado/venerable/ilustre over Nawat soot by seed. xu'te: Nawat xuta to wound over xuti snail by seed. tul: Nawat tal earth/tierra over Maya TUL numeral and Kiche tul reed by seed (same length). jare: no useful hit (Kiche xar blue bird / jarik wear out not adopted). elba: Spanish alba dawn (ilide) over Maya ALBA soften by seed.
Kuxte': Nawat kuxta arbol parecido al cacao over gunny-sack by seed. kíimil': Yucatec/ilide kíimil muerte/morir/deceso (death); longer than Nawat kimil load.
Tlaxye': no hit. le: Kiche le the over Maya LE aquel/ese by seed (same length); snare sense of LE rejected as less plausible with a name. Vaal: name.

translation: Not the day before yesterday, bug!
notes: Ma'oxe: MA' no + OXE' antier (day before yesterday). ik'el: bicho (bug), seed pick.
le'itzil: le the + Kiche itz devil/witchcraft (ITS Maya resin/tears is alt).
Xatlene: no hit. kujkuali: Nahuatl cualli good.

translation: Complaint, ask in, his ghost the buried one, niáach i'chian.
notes: 'Ayok: Maya AY queja particle + OK residue. ta': Kiche ta' to ask over Maya TA' gluttony by seed. en: Spanish en in (ilide en : ich, ichil) over 1sg -en by seed. u: Maya 3sg possessive (norma). mujuk': Kiche muj shadow/specter/ghost (j in surface); Maya MUUK fama is longer but poorer form. le: the. mucane: muka'n buried. niáach: no hit. i'chian: ICH face/rostro residue.

translation: You yonder, waja, tied-bundle, his other gourd!
notes: waja: no solid hit (WA'AN standing is stretch). yatle: yat tie-bundle. u'tra: Spanish otra (ilide otra vez) other. buxa: Maya BUX gourd/bujete.
fukuur: no exact hit. Spanish furor appears in Cordemex Spanish index but form is distant; left untranslated.
Xi: Maya XI chispa (spark); Nahuatl xi- imperative alt. daka: no hit (Cordemex dacaso is Spanish). puxe: Kiche puxa perhaps.
'Ayok as line 27. kifba: no hit. kilya: K'ILYAH. sakilja: Maya sakil blancura (whiteness) + ja (also ilide blanco : sak).
Ik'eche: IK' air + ACHE oh. sakilja: whiteness. atla: Maya ATLE Iabula (fable), longer than Nahuatl atl water. donuks: no hit.
Donuks: no hit. ko'soxsal: no hit. Cannot make the line.
Donuks: no hit. ko'mujuk: ko' + muj ghost/shadow (Kiche).

translation: Spark, its yonder obsidian-punish, you yonder enchantment, chief, I-base, the the Vaal, descend, qexcan...
notes: Xi: spark. u'te: 3sg + yonder. cha'tsoke: Kiche cha' obsidian (seed vs TSOK) + Maya TSOK castigar/arrancar. a'te: you yonder. itsok: ITS enchantment. xefe: Spanish jefe chief (ilide). yotlapek: Spanish yo I (ilide yo : in, kin) + Nahuatl tlapechtia serve as a base. le le: the the. te'moxti: Nahuatl/Campbell temo bajar (descend), residue xti; temoa search is longer alt. qexcan: no hit.
Na': Maya na' madre (mother) over Kiche na' to feel by seed. puyao: Kiche puy to stab (not to death); puyij bump is alt.

translation: In the base, its yonder stab, you yonder enchantment in the deformed calluses!
notes: Ich: Maya ICHIL in (ilide en : ich, ichil), longer than ICH face. tlapec: Nahuatl tlapechtia base. u'te: 3sg yonder. puyao: stab. a'te: you yonder. itsok: ITS. pu: Kiche pa in over pu become clear by seed. uch': Maya UCH' deformado/aplastado over Kiche uch' opossum by seed. ta'nuk: Maya TANAK calluses over TANOK planta del pie by seed.

translation: Miserable! Sculpt yonder, its yonder bug...
notes: Otsuks: Maya otsil miserable (longer than OTS shrink and TSUK heap). Tzokan'te: tzok' sculpt + te. u'te. ik'el: bug.
Proper name; no dictionary hit. Repeated vocative.

translation: You yonder living-overflow, tla-rubber turkey. Young boy, tla-rubber pine! Who who at the reward?
notes: A'te Kuxkal tlayeb kutsen as above. Ela: exact pool ala/ila/ILA; seed pick Kiche ala young boy (Spanish ala wing and Maya ILA look are alts). ukto: Nahuatl ocotl / Nawat uku-t ocote pine. Máax: ilide quién : máax (who) over MAAX shield by seed. ka: Nawat ka quien/who over Nahuatl ka where by seed. ti: TI' at. a'tul: Maya ATAL ser pagado/galardonado (paid/rewarded).
Proper name vocative.
